hook.name: RallyHookU4
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 token launch hook implementing a bonding-curve phase (CURVE) that transitions to a free-market phase (BREAKOUT) upon reaching a target price. It acts as the sole liquidity provider, applies dynamic LP fees per swap direction, collects protocol fees with optional referral attribution, and uses delegatecall to a fixed fee-facet for fee distribution.
